arxiv-1910-05987.title: Distance formulas in Bruhat-Tits building of SL d ​ ( ℚ p ) \mathrm{SL}_{d}(\mathbb{Q}_{p})
arxiv-1910-05987.creator: Dominik Lachman
arxiv-1910-05987.description: Abstract We study the distance on the Bruhat-Tits building of the group SL d ​ ( ℚ p ) \mathrm{SL}_{d}(\mathbb{Q}_{p}) (and its other combinatorial properties). Coding its vertices by certain matrix representatives, we introduce a way how to build formulas with combinatorial meanings.

arxiv-2209-03233.title: Quantifying the redshift space distortion of the bispectrum III : Detection prospects of the multipole moments 2022 Quantifying the redshift space distortion of the bispectrum III : Detection prospects of the multipole moments –
arxiv-2209-03233.creator: Arindam Mazumdar, Debanjan Sarkar, Somnath Bharadwaj
arxiv-2209-03233.description: Abstract The redshift space anisotropy of the bispectrum is generally quantified using multipole moments. The possibility of measuring these multipoles in any survey depends on the level of statistical fluctuations. We present a formalism to compute the statistical fluctuations in the measurement of bispectrum multipoles for galaxy surveys.

arxiv-2212-08764.title: Occupancy Grid Based Reactive Planner
arxiv-2212-08764.creator: 1 st Benjamin Hall, 2 nd Andrew Goeden, 3 rd Sahan Reddy, 4 th Timothy Gallion, 5 th Charles Koduru, 6 th M. Hassan Tanveer
arxiv-2212-08764.description: Abstract This paper proposes a perception and path planning pipeline for autonomous racing in an unknown bounded course. The pipeline was initially created for the 2021 evGrandPrix autonomous division and was further improved for the 2022 event, both of which resulting in first place finishes.

arxiv-2404-07883.title: Apprentice Tutor Builder: A Platform For Users to Create and Personalize Intelligent Tutors DOI: XXXXXXX.XXXXXXX Conference: Make sure to enter the correct conference title from your rights confirmation emai; June 03–05, 2018; Woodstock, NY ISBN: 978-1-4503-XXXX-X/18/06
arxiv-2404-07883.creator: Glen Smith, Adit Gupta, Chris MacLellan
arxiv-2404-07883.description: Abstract . Intelligent tutoring systems (ITS) are effective for improving students’ learning outcomes. However, their development is often complex, time-consuming, and requires specialized programming and tutor design knowledge, thus hindering their widespread application and personalization. We present the Apprentice Tutor Builder (ATB), a platform that simplifies tutor creation and personalization. Instructors can utilize ATB’s drag-and-drop tool to build tutor interfaces.

arxiv-2406-04017.title: Self-resonance during preheating: The case of 𝜶 \alpha -attractor models
arxiv-2406-04017.creator: Daniel del-Corral
arxiv-2406-04017.description: Abstract In this paper, for the first time, we obtain a new class of solutions for the Hill-type differential equations, which emerge in the preheating self-resonance phase of the expanding Universe. We study, in particular, the class of symmetric and asymmetric scalar field potentials coming from the so-called α \alpha -attractor models of the early Universe cosmology.

arxiv-2407-18457.title: Improved randomized neural network methods with boundary processing for solving elliptic equations
arxiv-2407-18457.creator: Zhou, Huifang, Sheng, Zhiqiang
arxiv-2407-18457.description: Abstract We present two improved randomized neural network methods, namely RNN-Scaling and RNN-Boundary-Processing (RNN-BP) methods, for solving elliptic equations such as the Poisson equation and the biharmonic equation. The RNN-Scaling method modifies the optimization objective by increasing the weight of boundary equations, resulting in a more accurate approximation.

arxiv-2506-03758.title: Scaling CrossQ with Weight Normalization
arxiv-2506-03758.creator: Daniel Palenicek, Florian Vogt, Jan Peters
arxiv-2506-03758.description: Abstract Reinforcement learning has achieved significant milestones, but sample efficiency remains a bottleneck for real-world applications. Recently, CrossQ has demonstrated state-of-the-art sample efficiency with a low update-to-data ( utd ) ratio of 1. In this work, we explore CrossQ’s scaling behavior with higher utd ratios.

arxiv-2509-03537.title: AR 2 : Adversarial Reinforcement Learning for Abstract Reasoning in Large Language Models CCS: Computing methodologies Natural language processing CCS: Computing methodologies Adversarial learning CCS: Software and its engineering Automatic programming
arxiv-2509-03537.creator: Cheng-Kai Yeh, Hsing-Wang Lee, Chung-Hung Kuo, Hen-Hsen Huang
arxiv-2509-03537.description: Abstract . Abstraction–the ability to recognize and distill essential computational patterns from complex problem statements–is a foundational skill in computer science, critical both for human problem-solvers and coding-oriented large language models (LLMs). Despite recent advances in training LLMs for code generation using reinforcement learning (RL), most existing approaches focus primarily on superficial pattern recognition, overlooking explicit training for abstraction.

arxiv-2601-10637.title: Measuring the Coronal Magnetic Field with 2D Coronal Seismology: A Forward-Modeling Validation CHIANTI, FORWARD
arxiv-2601-10637.creator: Zihao Yang, Matthias Rempel, Sarah Gibson, Giuliana de Toma
arxiv-2601-10637.description: A 2026 arXiv research paper by Zihao Yang, Matthias Rempel, Sarah Gibson, Giuliana de Toma. In recent years, a two-dimensional (2D) coronal seismology technique applied to spectral-imaging data from the Coronal Multi-channel Polarimeter (CoMP) and UCoMP has enabled routine measurement of the global coronal magnetic field. The technique combines coronal transverse wave phase speed from Doppler measurements with electron densities from the Fe xiii 10798/10747 Å intensity ratio to infer the magnetic field strength, while the wave propagation directions from Doppler measurements trace the magnetic field direction.

pmc-10601230.title: Mapping stunted children in Ethiopia using two decades of data between 2000 and 2019. A geospatial analysis through the Bayesian approach
pmc-10601230.creator: Kendalem Asmare Atalell, Masresha Asmare Techane, Bewuketu Terefe, Tadesse Tarik Tamir
pmc-10601230.description: BackgroundChildhood stunting is a major public health problem globally, resulting in poor cognition and educational performance, low adult wages, low productivity, and an increased risk of nutrition-related chronic diseases in adulthood life. Accurate and reliable data on the prevalence of stunting over time with a sub-national estimate are scarce in Ethiopia.

pmc-10744814.title: Real-World Data on Second-Line Therapy with Ramucirumab for Metastatic Gastric Cancer: A Two-Center Study on Romanian Population
pmc-10744814.creator: Diana Galos, Loredana Balacescu, Radu Vidra, Daniel Sur
pmc-10744814.description: (1) Background: Following the results of RAINBOW and REGARD trials, ramucirumab was approved as the standard second-line treatment for patients with advanced or metastatic gastric or gastroesophageal junction (GEJ) cancer, alone or in combination with paclitaxel. The present study aimed to evaluate the efficacy and safety of ramucirumab in the Romanian population during every-day clinical practice.

pmc-11440612.title: PARP enzymes and mono-ADP-ribosylation: advancing the connection from interferon-signalling to cancer biology
pmc-11440612.creator: Barbara Morone, Giovanna Grimaldi
pmc-11440612.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). ADP-ribosyltransferases of the PARP family encompass a group of enzymes with variegated regulatory functions in cells, ranging from DNA damage repair to the control of cell-cycle progression and immune response. Over the years, this knowledge has led to the use of PARP1/2 inhibitors as mainstay pharmaceutical strategies for the treatment of ovarian, pancreatic, prostate and breast cancers, holding mutations in genes encoding for proteins involved in the DNA repair mechanisms (synthetic lethality).

pmc-11515532.title: Factors contributing to organelle genomes size variation and the intracellular DNA transfer in Polygonaceae
pmc-11515532.creator: Yi Xiong, Xiong Lei, Yanli Xiong, Yingjie Liu, Zhixiao Dong, Junming Zhao, Qingqing Yu, Xiao Ma
pmc-11515532.description: The use of complete organelle genomes, including chloroplast and mitochondrial genomes, is a powerful molecular method for studying biological evolution and gene transfer. However, in the case of Polygonaceae, an important family with numerous edible, medicinal, and ornamental species, the mitochondrial genomes of only three species have been sequenced and analyzed.

pmc-12564953.title: A Comparative Study of the No-Punch Technique in Reducing Surgical Complications Associated with Unilateral Biportal Endoscopic Spine Surgery
pmc-12564953.creator: Jwo-Luen Pao, Chun-Chien Chang, Lindsay A Farrer, Adham M Khalafallah, Gregory W Basil
pmc-12564953.description: Background/Objectives: Unilateral biportal endoscopic spine surgery (UBE) has gained popularity due to its minimal invasiveness, endoscopic magnification, bloodless visual field, and broad application to various spinal disorders. We proposed the “no-punch” technique for UBE spine surgery, emphasizing its capability to prevent neural injury and preserve facet joints.

pmc-12581545.title: Ultrahigh-throughput screening of heterogeneous vancomycin-intermediate Staphylococcus aureus based on fluorescence-activated droplet sorting
pmc-12581545.creator: Xin Cheng, Zerui Wang, Yadong Liu, Liyan Ma, Zhiyi Wang, Yuxin Qiao, Wenbin Du, Shuilong Guo, Dongwei Chen, Jianrong Su
pmc-12581545.description: BackgroundHeterogeneous vancomycin-intermediate Staphylococcus aureus (hVISA) is associated with suboptimal glycopeptide treatment outcomes. However, conventional antimicrobial susceptibility testing fails to distinguish hVISA from vancomycin-susceptible Staphylococcus aureus (VSSA), potentially delaying effective therapy. The gold standard population analysis profiling with area under the curve (PAP-AUC) method is labor-intensive and time-consuming, necessitating rapid detection alternatives.

pmc-13410358.title: Oral Health Implications of GLP-1 Receptor Agonists and Other Incretin-Based Therapies
pmc-13410358.creator: Julia Bijoch
pmc-13410358.description: Incretin-based therapies have transformed the management of obesity and type 2 diabetes mellitus (T2DM). Established agents—the glucagon-like peptide-1 receptor agonists (GLP-1 RAs) semaglutide and liraglutide, and the dual GIP/GLP-1 receptor agonist tirzepatide—are now widely used, while a diverse pipeline of multi-receptor agents is advancing through late-phase development.

pmc-13454343.title: Imperatorin restores behavioral and recognition memory deficits induced by REM sleep deprivation in male rats
pmc-13454343.creator: Mohammad Mojtaba Ayati, Maryam Eslami, Batool Ghorbani Yekta
pmc-13454343.description: Many studies have shown the deleterious effects of rapid-eye movement (REM) sleep deprivation (SD) on cognitive functions and synaptic plasticity markers. On the other hand, imperatorin (IMP, extracted from the fruits of Angelica dahurica and Peucedanum praeruptorum) may exert significant pro-cognitive and neuroprotective effects.

pmc-13611940.title: Bacterial Pneumonia in Horses: Insights from a 10-Year European Single-Centre Retrospective Study
pmc-13611940.creator: Sabita D. Stoeckle, Henrike Friedrich, Katharina C. Jensen, Heidrun Gehlen
pmc-13611940.description: Simple SummaryEquine bacterial pneumonia typically occurs after predisposing events such as aspiration during oesophageal obstruction or general anaesthesia. This study examined 81 horses suffering from bacterial lung disease over a period of 10 years (January 2015–December 2024). Horses infected with primary pathogens such as Rhodococcus equi or Streptococcus equi ssp. equi were not included in the study.
